original_record.question: Carl built the shape shown using seven unit cubes. How many such cubes does he have to add to make a cube with edges of length 3 ? <image1>
original_record.solution: A cube with edges of length 3 is made up of $3^{3}=27$ unit cubes. Carl has already used seven cubes to build the initial shape so the number of cubes he needs to add is $27-7=20$.
